items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Played with him a while back.

ctx.x: Eugene Benoit. He was on banjo. Sometimes he used to music. He's Pico. Played with him a while back. And a fellow by the name of Thomas Copeland, he was playing bass. A little woman by the name of Edna Francis, she was playing piano.
